hints: Add 35 mL of base. If base only watered the acid down, the pH would stay low. What does the meter say?
Base doesn't just dilute acid: its hydroxide ions react with the acid's hydrogen ions to make water. Once all the acid is used up, extra base makes the solution basic.
Set the base to exactly 25 mL and look for pH 7. Then add 10 mL more and watch it turn basic.
